authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: This elicited drinking response literally combines pani “water” with the khā eat/consume verb. CDIAL 8082 supplies the water noun and 3865 the khā stem; the regional khānā construction also includes drinking in Platts. Both components are represented in their source order, including the ordinary verbal ending in khava; no auxiliary or noun is silently dropped.
